messages:
deploy-bot: Emergency hotpatch request: embeddings-service image rwinference/embeds:1.2.5-hotfix-b. CI green. Preflight checks OK. Requesting expedited canary + rapid ramp. Logs: https://logs.redwood/embeds/1755558888 :rotating_light:

eng-marta: Short summary: regression in batch-coalescer causing tail latency for tiny payloads and occasional 502s on retry path. Patch is a single-line selector fix. Rollback target: rwinference/embeds:1.2.5 (last stable).

sre-zoe: Need explicit rollback triggers and owner who will execute. Suggest triggers: 5xx spike >0.4% sustained for 3m OR p95 increase >250ms for 5m. Who's monitoring?

oncall-lee: I'm oncall. I'll monitor and will post ROLLBACK INTENT here if thresholds met. Pager set to high for 90m.

release-evan: Need Eng + SRE + Product signoffs for expedited. Product?

product-rita: Product acked. Impact ~0.2% of customer requests. Approve expedited rollout. Customer blurb: "Fix for intermittent latency and 502s affecting short embedding queries. No model changes."

eng-marta: +1 from eng (codeowner). Proposed plan: canary (eu-west1) for 6m, then 30% for 8m, 80% for 12m, then full if no triggers. Keep `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeds --to-revision=1.2.5` handy and traffic-cut script.

qa-ash: Quick smoke tests passed on staging. Will run extended tiny-batch probe during canary.

release-evan: Evan -> tagging deploy. Need a brief release-note line here before public note.

eng-marta: Release note draft: "Fix batching selector for very small inputs causing increased latency and occasional 502s. No model changes."

release-evan: Approved. Posting to release notes after rollout.

deploy-bot: Canary starting: rwinference/embeds:1.2.5-hotfix-b -> canary host embed-canary-11 (eu-west1). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood/embeds/canary/1755558888

sre-zoe: Canary initial health: all checks passing. p95 back to baseline at 4m.

deploy-bot: Canary PASS at 6m. Starting ramp to 30% over 2m.

eng-marta: Observed a transient 5xx spike on one replica at canary start (node OOM on unrelated job). Recommend reprovisioning canary host to avoid noisy neighbor.

sre-zoe: Moving canary to embed-canary-13, hold ramp for 2m.

qa-ash: While holding, running tiny-batch probe against new canary host; no errors so far.

deploy-bot: Canary moved to embed-canary-13. Health PASS after 3m. Resuming ramp -> 30%.

release-evan: Mid-ramp check: product ok to proceed to 80% if stable for 8m.

sre-zoe: 30% stable for 8m. No error spikes, p95 within +30ms. Proceed to 80%.

eng-marta: 80% reached. Monitoring 12m. Keep rollback command ready: `kubectl rollout undo deployment/embeds --to-revision=1.2.5` and traffic cut: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/traffic/cut?service=embeds&target=1.2.5`

oncall-lee: All alert thresholds applied. Pager active.

sre-zoe: 9m into 80%: transient GC on one host caused a +90ms p95 blip, not near rollback threshold. Still under observation.

qa-ash: Running extended regression suite, no failures.

deploy-bot: Finalizing rollout: switching 100% traffic to rwinference/embeds:1.2.5-hotfix-b. Deployment complete. Artifact SHA: 0a1b2c3d.

product-rita: Thanks team. Queue customer-facing note to go out in 30m after post-deploy checks.

release-evan: Scheduling 2h post-deploy quick sync to confirm stability and capture learnings. Filing follow-up: add unit test for batch-coalescer and telemetry alert for tiny-batch p99. Jira: https://jira.redwood/browse/ENG-10012

eng-marta: I'll open a PR to backfill tests and add canary early-warning metric.

oncall-lee: Pager will stay active for 2h. If I post ROLLBACK INTENT here, I will include metric dump + execute rollback immediately.

release-evan: Closing thread: hotpatch rolled and approvals recorded. If any regression, reopen thread. :heavy_check_mark:
